sources.snippet: What this is not. This is a verifier-constrained symbolic-rewrite policy over LEMMA's own rule vocabulary. It is not a general-purpose mathematical reasoner, not a theorem prover, not a language model, and not a state-of-the-art system. It cannot read a word problem, does not accept natural language, does not emit mathematics on its own, and produces no output that is meaningful outside LEMMA ...
